tools.name: calculate_class_grades
tools.description: Use this when a teacher or tutor wants a weighted grade calculator for a whole class; list ID and info columns (student number, StudentID, email, SIS, section) in ignore_columns so they stay out of the grades. Examples: final grades from a gradebook, 'calculate my students' grades with Homework 20%,

tools.name: generate_progress_reports
tools.description: Use this when the user wants a progress report template filled in for students; list ID and info columns (student number, StudentID, email, SIS, section) in ignore_columns so they stay out of the grades. Examples: printable progress reports, grade reports for parents, 'make a progress report for eac

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: calculate_class_grades, generate_progress_reports · Private data: calculate_class_grades · Public sink: calculate_class_grades, generate_progress_reports · Destructive: calculate_class_grades.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: calculate_class_grades, generate_progress_reports · Private data: calculate_class_grades · Public sink: calculate_class_grades, generate_progress_reports · Destructive: calculate_class_grades

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
